programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical…it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip…to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with three couples on the verge of ending their marriages.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Danielle says that her husband of nearly 10 years, John, has been living a secret life -- reaching out to men on Craigslist for sex and looking at child pornography. John insists that the child porn was accidentally downloaded, and while he admits to exchanging emails with men online, he maintains that he never met up with anyone in person. How does he explain his actions? And, what will the results of a polygraph test reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sandie says she desperately hopes to win back her ex-husband, Chris, so they can be a family again with their adopted 11-year-old daughter, but Chris’ ex-girlfriend, Aileen, will stop at nothing to keep them apart. Sandie says Aileen is stalking and harassing her, making false reports of abuse and neglect to CPS, and even created a fake profile on Facebook to talk trash about her -- and she wants Aileen prosecuted. Sandie says she and Chris have filed a total of nine peace orders against Aileen, but only the last one filed by Chris was granted, protecting him -- but not Sandie or their daughter. Aileen admits to intentionally causing trouble but says Sandie deserves it, because she destroyed Aileen’s relationship with Chris -- and she also wants him back. Chris says he’s tired of being caught in the middle of his exes and isn’t interested in a relationship with either one, other than co-parenting with Sandie -- but is he sending mixed messages? Can this trio reach a truce and learn to respect boundaries?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look into the nanny affair that shattered a marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: t’s been almost four months since 5-year-old Summer Wells vanished from her home in rural Tennessee on June 15, 2021. Her parents, Don and Candus, say they believe their daughter was abducted. But, the couple say online bullies have accused them of having something to do with Summer’s disappearance. Don and Candus agreed to sit down with body language experts Scott Rouse and Greg Hartley, interrogators who have worked with the FBI, law enforcement and the military and have been referred to as a human lie detector, in hopes of clearing their name. Find out what the men think and if Dr. Phil agrees with their findings.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Planning the wedding of your dreams can quickly turn into a nightmare. What is supposed to be a bonding experience between moms and daughters often turns into a battleground over everything from money to cake! Kristina and her mom, Cheri, know this all too well. Kristina says her mom’s lies are tearing their relationship apart, and if things don't change, she's uninviting her to the wedding! Will Cheri learn honesty is the best policy, and walk beside her daughter down the aisle? Then, get a front-row seat and behind-the-scenes look at the most special day in Dr. Phil and Robin's life: Jay's wedding. See the preparation, the ceremony and the huge celebration. Plus, the surprise gift of a lifetime from Jay's younger brother, Jordan, and the unique ideas that made this day one the McGraw's will treasure forever. A not-to-miss exclusive!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These parents say their precious daughters have turned into bullies. Dr. Phil spells out how "commando parenting" will reshape the behavior of their "little mean girls."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Jeremy, a funeral escort, who is being accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been edited and leaked online, and as a result, he is being defamed and bullied in the media. But, Jeremy says the world has it all wrong and wants to clear his name. Today, Dr. Phil meets a funeral director who has worked with Jeremy for seven years, as well as someone who’s been following his story from afar. What do they have to say? Plus, to help prove his intention is not to impersonate a police officer, Jeremy requested a polygraph test. What does the test reveal? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From petty theft to check fraud, Dr. Phil's guests say they're addicted to stealing, and it's destroying their families.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jeremy owns his own funeral escort company but says he’s being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been leaked online, received millions of views, and as a result, he is being victimized in his community and misrepresented in the media – and now, he and his attorney want to set the record straight. Dr. Phil meets Jeremy and takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge. Is Jeremy “playing cop” or just doing his job? And, what’s on Jeremy’s duty belt? You won’t want to miss part one of this two-part show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother who is nealty 700 pounds struggles to gets her life on track.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dan and Teresa say their 16-year-old identical twins, Dallas and Drew are violent, destructive and dangerous, and they fear someone will end up seriously hurt, or even dead. What’s at the root of the teens’ anger and extreme jealousy that’s driving them apart? Could the parents be contributing to the explosive situation? Broken bones, violent fights, destruction of property -- today’s guests aren’t enemies; they are 16-year-old identical twin brothers. Dr. Phil examines the jealousy and torment that's driving these siblings apart and throwing their home into chaos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Should transgender athletes be allowed to compete with those of the gender they identify with or must they only compete with athletes who share the gender they were assigned at birth? Are laws that ban transgender women from participating in women's sports fair? LGBTQ+ activists have described criteria limiting transgender athlete involvement in gendered sports as "discriminatory.” Lia Thomas made headline news and stirred debate when she competed in swimming nationals as a transgender woman. Dr. Phil, along with Layne Ingram, a transgender man and basketball coach, and Olympic swimmer Nancy Hogshead-Makar, an advocate for girls and women in sports and CEO of Champion Women, discuss what they believe is right and fair. Then, Riley Gaines, who competed against Lia Thomas, gives her perspective on how she felt after their race. The big question is: what does the science say? Harvard professor Dr. Carole Hooven breaks it down.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ray and Deena say that three years ago, after Deena had an affair and they divorced, their 16-year-old daughter, Summer, went from a straight-A student to a violent and out of control teen. The parents say that Summer shoplifts, uses drugs, gets into physical fights with friends and family, dresses provocatively and lies about her age to date much older men. They also claim that she has run away from home at least 15 times -- including a month-long ordeal in Las Vegas, when they say Summer lived on the streets, abused drugs and panhandled for money. How does Summer explain her behavior? Hear why she says she had no choice but to run away to Vegas -- with a near-stranger. And, how do Ray and Deena respond? Has the contention between them compromised their ability to parent Summer? Dr. Phil weighs in and offers the fractured family advice for moving forward. Will the parents be willing to come together to get Summer back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most stressful times in a couple's life is the planning of their wedding. Hundreds of decisions need to be made, ranging from who makes the guest list to who picks up grandma at the airport. These guests have some tough wedding-related decisions to make and they turn to Dr. Phil for the answers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil debates viewers who disagree with the advice he gave to previous guests. One woman feels he had no right to push his view of adoption on pregnant 15-year-old, Alexandra. Another woman accuses Dr. Phil of bullying the participants on the Weight Loss Challenge and even accuses him of disliking fat people! What does Dr. Phil say about her inflated accusations? Then a 16-year-old bi-racial girl disputes Dr. Phil’s advice to a mother facing a racial identity crisis. How will these viewers fare when they go head to head with Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nichole claims her husband gets violent when he drinks which he denies. And, Theresa and Steve say their son Steven’s rage is out of control, and they fear for their lives. Plus, two victims of a road rage incident caught on tape share their story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you rather be right or happy? Dr. Phil talks with some right-fighters who can't settle their debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Wrath of My Mother Wanda (PT 1)
programme.desc: Things get a little wild with a very passionate guest named Wanda. Her daughter, Tiffany, told her mother she ruined her wedding, among many other things. But Wanda says Tiffany is making up lies about her and she knows why; Wanda claims it’s payback for Wanda having an affair and abandoning the family when Tiffany was just 14 years old. Wanda says her bipolar disorder is at fault for her earlier actions. Tiffany says she is sick of her mother blaming her mental health issues for her bad behavior. Tiffany says if Dr. Phil can’t fix this, then her mother is out of her life for good. Can Dr. Phil get this mother-daughter duo to see eye to eye for the first time?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikki says her three-year marriage has turned volatile. She claims her husband, Mark, has punched her in the face, broken her nose and run over her toe with his truck -- among other allegations -- which he denies. Mark claims Nikki instigates most of their fights and has violent outbursts, and he suspects she might be trying to kill him. The couple admits their confrontations happen in front of their two young children, and both say they want to save their marriage. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of their kids. Can this toxic relationship be healed?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.desc: Ray Scott had no plan other than a hypothetical idea of launching a legitimate pro bass fishing tour. Through his uncanny salesmanship the 1967 All-American was a success leading to the formation of the Bass Anglers Sportsman Society (B.A.S.S.).

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: By the 1980s B.A.S.S. was gaining national media notoriety while membership swelled to nearly 500 000. The Bassmasters TV series debuted in 1984 to capture the drama as it unfolded on the water. The show followed the Bassmaster Tournament Trail.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Bill Dance a furniture salesman from Memphis Tenn. caught the first bass in Scott’s 1967 All-American tournament a harbinger of great things to come. Dance went on to become the sport’s first superstar fueled by his outgoing charisma.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Roland Martin early on established himself as a B.A.S.S. superstar by winning 19 tournaments. Jimmy Houston’s recognizable giggle mop of blonde hair and wide-framed sunglasses made him an instant hit.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Hank Parker who won the Classic in 1979 and 1989 also won 1983 B.A.S.S. Angler of the Year. In 14 years as a B.A.S.S. pro Parker qualified for 14 Classics before retiring at the age of 37 going on to be successful with his Hank Parker Outdoor Magazine.

programme.title: The Cast

programme.title: Episode 5: Monster Jam and Rally Jameel
programme.desc: Gearing Up is back with another thrilling episode that takes you on an exhilarating journey around the globe, showcasing the most unique and intense competitions the world has to offer. In this episode, high skills, a passion for technology, an impatience for innovation, and a pure love for adrenaline are combined at their best. Buckle up, rev your engines, and get ready for some electrifying action as you experience the thrill of full G-force! The episode kicks off with Monster Jam’s action. Monster Jam drivers are the best of the best. They make 6-ton Monster Jam trucks defy gravity and wow fans around the world. Each driver has a signature stunt they can’t wait to perform during the event. In this episode, some of Monster Jam’s most technical drivers will break down their favourite skills. Then we go to Rally Jameel. As the first women-only navigational rally in the Middle East, it has returned with its highly anticipated fourth edition and its first-ever cross-border expansion. Spanning five days and covering a 1,600-kilometer route across two countries, this year’s rally represents a historic expansion beyond Saudi Arabia, as everything would start from Petra, Jordan. Lastly, finish off this episode by featuring the WaterJet World Series, one of the premier international jet ski racing competitions, typically consisting of several rounds held in different countries and continents.

programme.title: What Horner's sacking really means for Verstappen, F1 and Red Bull
programme.desc: After 20 years of service as Team Principal of Red Bull Racing, Christian Horner has been sacked by the team with immediate effect, with Laurent Meikes replacing Horner as Red Bull CEO, and Alan Permane taking Meikes’ job as Racing Bulls Team Principal. James Allen is joined in the studio to analyse the news with our correspondents Ronald Vording, Christian Nimmervoll and Ben Hunt to analyse what led to Horner’s sacking, what role Max Verstappen and his camp may have played in the decision, and what it means for Red Bull, Racing Bulls, and maybe even Ferrari in the future…

programme.title: Which of Marc Marquez's MotoGP victories make him a future racing legend?
programme.desc: Marc Márquez is widely considered one of the greatest motorcycle racers of all time, he previously raced for the Ducati satellite team Gresini in 2024 and Honda's factory team from his MotoGP debut in 2013 until 2023. At present he races for the Ducati Lenovo Team and is predicted to win the MotoGP Championship this year. Hearing from his past and present team, we learn all the stories from behind the scenes. From photoshoots, injuries, mistakes and laughs, let's look back on Marquez's greatest races so far.

programme.title: From Wheelchair to Race Car - How Robert Wickens Overcame the Odds
programme.desc: In 2018, a horrific crash at Pocono nearly ended Robert Wickens’ life—and seemingly ended his racing career. He suffered a double spinal cord fracture, multiple broken bones, and a severe pulmonary contusion. By the end of that year, Robert revealed he was a paraplegic. But Robert Wickens is not like most people. This is the story of a man who refused to be defined by the crash that changed everything. Through unwavering determination, incredible resilience, and the cutting-edge technology of Bosch Motorsport, Robert set his sights on an unthinkable goal: to race again at the highest level. This isn’t just a story about recovery—it's about rediscovery. About holding onto your identity, chasing your dreams, and proving that hope can overcome even the most impossible odds.

programme.title: Road to 2026, Episode 1: The Journey So Far
programme.desc: Before looking to the future and 2026's regulation changes, first we must look back at the past. In episode one of our new Road to 2026 series with ‪PETRONAS Motorsports‬ we look at the history of the partnership, the origin of hybrid technology in F1, and how, together, we've pushed the boundaries of innovation.

programme.title: Le Mans Classic 2025
programme.desc: Step back in time at Le Mans Classic, where we meet legendary race drivers and passionate car collectors to explore the enduring legacy of vintage machines. From the roaring icons of 1923 to the sleek speedsters of the ’90s, experience the full spectrum of historic racing — on and off the track.

programme.title: Motorsport Images: An Enduring Legacy
programme.desc: 26 million images. 100 years of racing. This is the story of Motorsport Images, the premiere photographic agency and archive covering motorsport and motoring. It is unique in that it provides photography of all major current motorsport events, from Formula One Grand Prix racing to national level racing, as well as archive images documenting the history of the sport dating back to 1895.

programme.title: 2 + 4 = 24 documentary
programme.desc: 1 Rider. 1 Driver. 2 Races - each over 24 hours. 24 hours are always tough, no matter where you do it. Australian bike rider Josh Hook on Honda Fireblade and Portuguese racing driver Tiago Monteiro on Honda Civic Type R walk us through the challenging endurance races in detail and answer the question: what is it like to be a 2-wheel and 4-wheel race gladiator? Follow Josh Hook and Tiago Monteiro to the edges of hell and back in the two toughest 24 Hour races of 2020: 24 Hours of Nurburgring and 24 Heures Motos at Le Mans.

programme.title: F1's Fiercest Rivalries with Karun Chandhok

But what pair takes the Number 1 spot? Autosport Editor-In-Chief Kevin Turner sits down with former driver and Sky Sports F1 broadcaster Karun Chandhok to debate who they think are the Top 10 greatest rivalries in the sport’s 75-year history. Let us know who you think F1’s greatest rivalry was in the comments, and check back soon for a new series of F1 Top 10 Podcasts!

programme.title: Episode 3: Monster Jam and UIM XCAT World Championship
programme.desc: In this episode, cutting-edge technology and unparalleled skill combine to create a pulse-pounding race of innovation and adrenaline. Buckle up, rev your engines, and get ready for some electrifying action as you experience the thrill of full G-force! The episode kicks off with the high-octane action of Monster Jam in Qatar! With significant investments in local championships and state-of-the-art facilities, Qatar is on a mission to empower the next generation of drivers and bring world-class events, like the WEC, to the Middle East. Meet Classroom Crusher, the newest Monster Jam truck that’s too cool for school and ready to break all the rules. Next, we head to Fujairah, the "home" of the UIM XCAT World Championship, where tradition meets technology. The 2025 season of this iconic series promises fierce competition with returning stars and exciting new challengers. Men and machines unite on the water for what promises to be the most thrilling season yet. The opening race of the 2025 season isn’t just a test of speed—it’s a grueling endurance challenge. With unpredictable conditions, massive waves, and shifting winds, both competitors and their machines will face their toughest test yet. Who will rise to the occasion and conquer the elements? And that's a wrap on the third episode of 2025!

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: Twisting Knives
programme.desc: AMCOP Exclusive Movie. A young lady who believes she is in an incredibly happy marriage with her husband, finds out, just before his death, that he had cheated on her for years and had kept a second family away from her. Her misery is compounded when she finds out that her mother-in-law had knowledge of her husband’s other family. Bitterness eats at her as she believes everyone knew about her late husband’s treachery and she decides to twist knives in their hearts so they too will feel the pain of betrayal.

CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | The Old World - Episode 10
programme.desc: When the tour moves on to Europe, Kelly reconnects with one of his oldest and closest friends, Stephen "Belly" Bell, a longtime tour manager who's retiring after the season. Disappointing results in France and Portugal, combined with his friend's retirement, force Kelly to consider his own career timeline.

programme.title: Kelly Slater: The Lost Tapes
programme.sub-title: Kelly Slater: Lost Tapes | Curtain Call - Episode 11
programme.desc: In the finale, Kelly arrives on the North Shore of Oahu earlier than usual and decides to surf the Triple Crown in the lead-up to the final Championship Tour event at Pipeline. With a run of good swell and the eyes of the entire surfing world on Pipe, Kelly ends the season on a high note by scoring a perfect 10, winning his first Triple Crown in 21 years, and finishing the season ranked 8th overall.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.sub-title: 2006 Billabong Pro Mundaka | THE WSL VAULT
programme.desc: Flashing back to a classic event at the premiere Spanish lefthander.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Surf Abu Dhabi Pro 2025
programme.desc: The WSL Championship Tour makes its groundbreaking debut in the Middle East in this Replay of the 2025 Surf Abu Dhabi Pro Final Series. The second stop on the CT marks professional surfing's continued global expansion and also establishes Abu Dhabi as an official surf destination. Engineered for excellence, this high-performance wave provides a canvas for the world's best surfers, set against the stunning backdrop of the Arabian Gulf.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | A Last Chance For Surfing Glory At Pipeline And Honolua Bay
programme.desc: The European leg of the WSL World Tour season is finished and Kanoa Igarashi and Steph Gilmore are off to Hawaii, where a year's worth of surfing their hearts out will culminate at two of the best waves in the world: Maui's Honolua Bay and Oahu's Pipeline. See how Kanoa and Steph handle the mounting pressure in this episode of All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour.

programme.title: WSL Competition Highlights
programme.desc: See all the best scores from the WSL surfing season.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero 2025
programme.desc: The MEO Rip Curl Pro Portugal presented by Corona Cero Replay showcases elite surfing at Supertubos, one of Europe's premier beach-breaks known for its powerful, hollow waves and consistent barrels. As the third stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, this event is crucial for competitors looking to build momentum in their World Title campaigns.

programme.title: All In: Life on the WSL Championship Tour
programme.sub-title: All In | Kanoa And Steph Fight Back In The Peaks of Supertubos
programme.desc: After disappointing results at the Quiksilver and Roxy Pros in Hossegor, France, the pressure mounts for Kanoa Igarashi and Steph Gilmore as they head into the second-to-last event of the WSL World Tour season, the Rip Curl Pro at Peniche, Portugal's Supertubos.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Wolves' Weddings | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 2
programme.desc: Sam, Lucy, and Erwan head to the naturally beautiful Kabyle region along with locals Dihya Nasri and Walid Assef. Once there, they surf some clean, cold, and completely uncrowded peelers and get some famous ice cream in Béjaïa, a market city known for its rich music scene, vibrant clothing, and incredible views of the Sapphire Coast. They then explore the stunning Cap Carbon headlands and learn about the native Berber culture and ancient Kabyle language.

programme.title: UNBOXING THINGS with Koa Smith
programme.sub-title: WSL | Unboxing Things With Koa Smith
programme.desc: Koa Smith takes a look at all the latest surfing gear.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach presented by Bonsoy 2025
programme.desc: Bells Beach on Victoria's South Coast is the longest-running surfing competition and will host the 62st edition this year. Bells is Australian surfing heritage. With the hope of scoring long-period, groomed walls, the surfers will need to display the perfect combination of power, precision, and timing. The biggest surfing legends have had the honor of winning and ringing ‘The Bell' and 2025 will see a hungry new generation vying for the opportunity to cement their names in one of surfing's most prestigious events.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.sub-title: YOUR FAVORITE SURFERS FAVORITE EVENT! '06 Rip Curl Search Somewhere in Mexico RECAP | THE WSL VAULT
programme.desc: This Episode of the Vault takes us to right-hand perfection Barra de la Cruz when Andy Irons took the win over Taylor Knox in dreamy conditions. Featuring Surfing from Andy Irons, Kelly Slater, Bobby Martinez, Taj Burrow, Travis Logie, Taylor Knox, Timmy Reyes, Bruce Irons, and Chris Ward.

programme.title: The Lineup with Dave Prodan
programme.desc: Legendary surfer, 1977 World Champion, and WSL co-founder Shaun Tomson joins Dave Prodan for a deep dive into the past, present, and future of professional surfing.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners
programme.sub-title: Trans-Saharan Highway | Brilliant Corners: Algeria, Episode 3
programme.desc: After heading inland for a whirlwind adventure in the Sahara Desert, the crew says farewell to Lucy as she heads home to Australia. Back in Algiers, Sam, Erwan, and Dihya visit one of the country's leading digital agencies to discuss their journey and go for one last surf in some perfect longboard waves. Before leaving the country, Sam and Erwan talk with local surfers Dihya and Walid about the future of surfing in Algeria and how the emergence of the sport could impact the people there.

programme.title: WSL Replay
programme.sub-title: REPLAY | All the Action from the Western Australia Margaret River Pro 2025
programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour. Replay Final's Day at this crucial event, marking the mid-season cut, where the world's best surfers put it all on the line to advance through to the next section of the tour. Margaret River brings raw power, pumping waves and unforgettable drama.

programme.title: WSL Inside Pro Surfing
programme.sub-title: Inside Pro Surfing: Western Australia Margaret River Pro 2025
programme.desc: The Western Australia Margaret River Pro is the 7th stop on the 2025 World Surf League Championship Tour, running from May 17 to May 27. This crucial event marks the mid-season decider, where the world's best surfers put it all on the line to advance through the next section of the tour. It is also the third and final stop of the GWM Aussie Treble. Margaret River will bring the action with pumping waves and strong competition.

programme.title: Margaret River Pro
programme.sub-title: FINALS DAY MEN - 2017 Drug Aware Margaret River Pro
programme.desc: The 2017 Drug Aware Margaret River Pro will go down as the best one yet, with the first-ever action from North Point and historic performances at Margaret River's Main Break. programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We head out of the garage to visit one of the premiere supercharger manufacturers in the world… ATI Pro Charger. Follow along for the ride as Stacey walks through the entire process of how they have raised the bar on how a supercharger is built and what it does. From bulk metal to dyno runs, we’ve got it covered. Back in the garage, a young Gearhead drops by to learn how to install an air intake and cowl induction hood on his pick-up. After the wrench turning is done, he and Stacey have enough time to hit a few licks on their guitars. From massive horsepower increases with state-of-the-art tools and machinery, to simple intake and hood installs,….. it’s all here, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey is in full hot rod mode as he unveils a wicked LS engine and Tremec 6spd tranny and stuffs it into the Catalog Camaro. If 600hp and a 6spd in a Camaro doesn’t get you going, the update on the Stunt Double will! It’s old school cool as Stacey shows off the stainless light bar, side steps and cutout flairs to give the truck that “Fall Guy” vibe. After that we introduce you to the amazing world of scale R/C that is sure to have you re-thinking what you want for Christmas! Finally we roll in some updates on the Cheetah and the Junkyard Jag too. If you’re a gearhead, you’re gonna find a whole lot to love about this show!......and that’s GEARZ!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 12 opens with bang as Stacey starts the final assembly process on the V8 Interceptor. If you’ve ever wondered how to lay out an aftermarket A/C system, wiring harness, and steering column on your project… and make them all work together, you have to see this show! After that, NHRA legend and Hall-of-Famer, Doug Herbert drops by the GearZ garage to share the shocking story that inspired him to start the B.R.A.K.E.S. driving program. Hold on tight, because this ain't your typical high school driver's Ed. Program! If you want cool tech and awesome stories… you’re gonna find that on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about fabrication and thinking outside the box, or to be more specific... outside the bed! Sure, sure, there are plenty of custom pick-up truck beds you can buy but Stacey shows you what is involved in MAKING a custom bed to fit any vehicle, even something as crazy as a Thiokol Imp snowcat! That's right… our little snowcat is back from the sand blaster and ready for a cool bed to match the cab. Stacey goes in-depth about sizing up the project, picking the right parts, and most importantly: how to cut, weld, grind and finish sheet metal to get a bed that will fit your unique vehicle like a glove. So grab a welder… it’s time to make your bed!... only on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes a trip to Fort Carson, Colorado to visit the Army auto skills program during their world conference. Not only does Stacey get to meet a General, but he also meets a young Sergeant who is in the middle of a frame-off square body restoration. After a thorough walk around, Stacey decides to get LMC involved in helping out with this build. Parts for the bed of his truck can’t match the gratitude we share for our active military and all those who have served, but it’s a start. And we can’t wait to see the project when it’s finished. And speaking of new beds, with the custom bed on the Snow Cat, it’s time to address the tracks, and Right Track Systems has us covered. That little cat is going to tear it up when all is said and done! It’s going to be a lot of fun, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about Cougars! No, not that kind of Cougar... the kind with 4 wheels and a legendary pedigree! After a short history lesson about how these cars came into existence and why they were so cool, Stacey rolls the V8 Interceptor back into the shop and digs into the final assembly of this wild ’67 Mercury Cougar. This week’s episode focuses on planning out your final assembly, and taking care of all the little details, before you put the big things in like engine and transmission. Whether it’s planning out your brake system, battery location, or running fuel lines, Stacey shows how a little extra time in the planning department will make all the difference in your build.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey takes us through the history of the legendary SR-71 Blackbird. If you’re not familiar with this bird, it could fly mach 3.2, cruise at 80,000 feet and kept our country safe through its many reconnaissance missions. Never shot down, and never outrun, it was the hot rod of the sky! Stacey gets to sit down with pilot Lt. Col. Ed Yeilding and talk about his record setting transcontinental flight—Coast to Coast in 67 minutes and 54 seconds! The iconic Blackbird was such an inspiration that you know Stacey had to make a vehicle inspired by and paying tribute to it, so get ready to meet the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Catalog Camaro Butt Lift and Tummy Tuck
programme.desc: The Catalog Camaro is back in the garage and ready to go under the knife as Stacey shows how to do a butt lift and tummy tuck on a 2nd generation Camaro. What does that mean? Well, last season Stacey performed a nose job on this old ’81 Camaro to show how easy it is to get rid of the 80’s plastic front bumpers and put on the classic early 70’s split-bumper, rally sport front sheetmetal. This week he continues the makeover by losing the plastic rear bumper and wrap-around taillights and grafting in the early 70’s quarter panels, round taillights and chrome bumper. It’s more in depth than the front and definitely requires some skilled metal surgery, but Stacey shows you all the tricks on how to do it properly. So, sit back and enjoy the ride as Stacey details how to measure, cut, and weld your way to a much younger looking Camaro.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a Big Bad Buick Riviera and shows you what is possible with the right vehicle and some bolt on parts. This 1972 Riviera is a great entry-level project that won’t break the bank, and has the potential to serve some serious humble-pie to any unsuspecting hot shot that may want to mix it up at the stoplight. As it sits, the big 455 under the hood is a force to be reckoned with, but Stacey shows what a weekend in the garage and a top end rebuild can do for a car like this! Get ready to get your hands dirty and bust a few knuckles as Stacey pulls the old heads, intake, cam, and ignition off and replaces them with performance parts from companies like TA Performance, Edelbrock, and MSD. It’s a lesson in Buick and bolt-on horsepower, and you’re only gonna find it on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The GearZ crew hits the road this week and travels to the Charlotte Speed Shop to see how paint prep is going on Stacey’s Cheetah Evolution Car. With the hood and side vents glassed in and smoothed out, the first coat of primer gets sprayed and this awesome cat takes one big step closer to coming home! Stacey also stops by to visit with a fellow boat tail Riviera owner and trade tips on beefing up these classic beauties. It turns out that this guy and Stacey had both been watching this same car when it came up for sale! Come hang out with us as we visit some great folks this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey gets down to business on the Big Bad Buick. With the top end engine rebuilt, the exterior and interior of the car need some serious updating. You don’t have to spend a ton of cash on simple modifications. Stacey shows what’s behind making a good clean line with your bumpers and how a simple front and rear bumper tuck can drastically change the appearance. Replacing the grille and scraping off that old vinyl top are also sure-fire ways to add attitude to this big ol’ boat tail. That old carpet has got to go! Follow along as Stacey shows the ins and outs and some tips and tricks to keep your exterior and interior redo from breaking the bank.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Not everyone out there is wrenching on an a classic. In fact, we get tons of emails from viewers who want to upgrade brand-new vehicles but aren’t sure how to get started. Well, Stacey has the answer—and it comes with a little help from our friend and NASCAR legend Jimmie Johnson and a stunning 2018 Camaro SS. Come hang out in the garage as Stacey walks you through the top seven modifications that you can make to a car that you just drove off the lot! Everything from paint upgrades to wheels, Stacey’s got a list. Let’s get started!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey’s hard at work on a 2018 Camaro SS. This build is super-cool, not only because he’s running down a list of the top seven mods you can make on a brand-new car, but also because seven-time NASCAR champion, Jimmie Johnson is involved with the project. We’ve covered paint mods, body mods, and interior mods. Now it’s time to go under the hood and under the car and talk powers gains and handling upgrades!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With our chassis and drivetrain out of the way, it’s time to get moving on the inside of the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express. But how do you organize a bunch of tools in and empty truck? Well, the guys from Summit Bodyworks do it every day on full size Cornwell tool trucks, so it’s only natural that they lend a hand in helping layout the inside our ’59 Panel to make it cool and serviceable. After that, Stacey addresses the issue of wooden floors and beds, and shows you an aluminum floor option that you’d swear came from the forest. Finally, the crew hits the road and gets a chance to talk with top fuel drag racer Leah Pritchett about her drive to become one of the best top fuelers in the nation. From design to drag racing, we’ve got it covered, this week on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is really taking off! We get our custom chassis from the Roadster Shop—those guys know a thing or two about quality builds. Engine Master Jon Kaase delivers a one-of-a-kind engine to power our SR-71. This build is coming together fast! With the body back on, Stacey takes you through some of the other mods that are going to tie this build in with the SR-71 Blackbird. Get ready, ya’ll, we’ve got loads of good stuff on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Season 13 is off and rumbling with Stacey showing off the new exhaust system for the SR-71 Rapid Tool Express project. From the headers to the tailpipes, this exhaust is going to scream! After that, it’s chassis details as Stacey lays out a plan for pedals, brakes and a fuel tank. Of course You can’t have an SR-71 inspired build without some killer wheels and wait ‘til you see what Stacey and our good friends at Neely Precision come up with. It’s all good, and it’s all here, this week on GearZ

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The biggest Toy in the shop is back... HEAVY METAL! Yes... Our old junk yard International Tow Truck rolls back into the garage as the freshly painted cab returns from the Hot Rot Institute. And it’s not just any paint, It’s Razzleberry from Axalta that’s so candy, you’ll want to take a bite! But there’s no time for that because Stacey jumps right in to putting a face and interior back in this old junkyard dog. The result will make you really glad that he rescued this one from the crusher! It’s recycling at it’s best... it’s GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re moving full steam ahead with the Interior of the Heavy Metal cab coming together and now’s the time to get the dash set up. We’ve got new gauges, old gauges and a bunch of empty holes where switches and knobs lived in this truck’s former life. Stacey lays out the dos and donts of getting your dash updated and a layout that makes sense before it gets installed. GearZ hits the road with a special delivery for the Hot Rod Institute for all they’ve done for us and the restoration industry. Feeling a little down about your project? Well, Stacey has a tool tech that’s sure to lift you up! All this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express returns as Stacey digs into his old ’59 ford panel truck and shows how to convert it into a one-off tool delivery truck to show off a variety of Cornwell tools. From special shelves, lighting and floor, there are even a few surprises that are tucked away inside this rolling tool cart! Moving to the cab of the vehicle, Stacey addresses some of the issues people have when setting up seats and steering, and shows some simple tricks that make a huge difference in getting your seats and steering dialed in. Then it’s on the rear to lay out the gas tank, and then finally the SR-71 gets a new beak.... from a ’59 T-bird! ...What?!?.... how is that possible? Well, ya gotta watch GEARZ to find out!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Jeep may be the single most modified vehicle out there. From winches to lights, doors and fenders, if you’ve got a Jeep, it probably has some accessories on it. But despite all that, one of the best things about a Jeep is the removable top. It also sparks one of the biggest debates... What is best: a soft top or a hard top? Stacey takes on the challenge by comparing a factory hard top with the new Bestop Trektop. The test will include everything from ease of install to styling, overall sound decibels and of course, how watertight it is. Hopefully you won’t get wet on this ride! Then it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you that rotisseries aren’t just for chickens, and how an automotive rotisserie can make life in the shop a lot easier. Finally, it’s on to the right and wrong way to use weatherstrip adhesive to hold your rubbers on. Sound risqué? It’s not... it’s just GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about square body GM trucks, because The Stunt Double is back in the shop. First, we take a look back at the this awesome ‘86 Chevy 4x4 Silverado long bed build that pays tribute to the legendary Fall Guy TV truck. From its beginnings as a well-worn farm truck, you’ll see it get an upgraded suspension, interior, drivetrain, as we make it better than I was before... better... stronger... faster... wait, that was a DIFFERENT Lee Majors TV show! After that, we walk you through the paint job and show how it is similar to the Fall Guy truck, only different.... because It’s the Stunt Double!!! No hocus pocus... no movie magic... just a tough truck being built to handle the toughest stunts... only on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express is back on the block and going back together for the last time. Stacey finishes up the frame into a rolling masterpiece with the suspension and drivetrain assembled for the last time. Then the body goes back on, and the interior starts to go together. We’re talking fitting the carpet, steering column and the new dash bezel and stuffing that bezel with custom SR-71 gauges. After that, Stacey shows some tricks on how to choose the right transmission and why rechargeable power tools are giving the tried and true air tools a run for their money! It's all here and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the e85 market and flex fuel vehicles growing every day, Stacey dives into the myths and truths that surround ethanol and whether or not it’s a good choice for your vehicle. With a little help from Advanced Fuel Dynamics, Stacey installs a new fuel delivery system on a 2017 Mustang to show just how easy it is to up your performance and keep your engine safe at the same time. After that, Stacey and the crew head out west to tell the story of Bestop and how they’ve been making removable Jeep tops for decades. From rock-crawlers to the mall crawlers, Bestops unique past allows us to see what the future of the Jeep world will be. Finally, if you’re trying to decide between a stick or automatic transmission… hang out for a while as Stacey talks about converting your boring automatic to a lively manual transmission. We’ve got all this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s rare for people to reach the age of 100. It’s ever rarer for a business, but that just what Cornwell Quality Tools has done! Take a trip through the last century as Stacey tracks the development of a tool company started by a blacksmith, to the tool truck empire that stresses quality over everything else. Speaking of 100 years…trucks have been around for over a century, and for over a century, truck owners have struggled to find the best way to lift their trucks. Stacey sheds some light on picking the right kind of lift for the truck you’re driving. We’ve got all of this and more on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: There’s nothing like a good mystery. One of our favorite GearZ mysteries is the whereabouts of Copperhead, the legendary C10 that Stacey built more than a decade ago. It seemed like the truck just disappeared. Well, it’s back! And Stacey was reunited with it at the C10 Nationals in Ft. Worth, TX. Tag along as Stacey gets a chance to get behind the wheel again and boil some tires. Back in the garage, Stacey tackles a fuel injection install on a Jeep Scrambler, then checks out the new Core Doors from Bestop. There’s a lot going on and plenty of smoke on the Texas Motor Speedway on this episode of GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: SR-71 Fins, Logo and Mystery Paint
programme.desc: As the SR71 Rapid Tool Express nears completion there are a couple of major things left on the plate before we can fire her up and get her down the road. First, every aircraft must have fins, and Stacey finally finds the fins he’s been looking for since the beginning of this build. Second, a cool logo design shows up at the shop. Third, what’s a stealthy tribute vehicle without stealthy paint? Believe it or not, Stacey’s got some paint that should keep the SR71 flying under the radar. Also, a slightly modified March Performance system will help Stacey get that much closer to putting some spark to this awesome build and stick around for plenty of other tech advice from America’s Gearhead… on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re on the road, again, as Stacey visits a truck enthusiast working on his first ground up restoration. It’s a sweet, clean, square body that’s in good enough condition that it might be on the road in a couple of months. But every build can use a little push, and GearZ On the Road does just that! After that, we dig into toolboxes. Hang out as Stacey talks with two engineers about what makes the new Cornwell Platinum boxes so tough. From rollers to welds, these might be the Ultimate box! Then the Cheetah is back in the garage, but only for a day or two before it heads out to get the body work finished and get some new color. It’s all here on GearZ.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: STACEY DIGS INTO A PROJECT THAT SHOWS YOU JUST HOW MUCH FUN YOU CAN HAVE FOR ALMOST NO MONEY. BECAUSE HE’S TAKING A DERELECT 70’S ATV, STUFFING IN A JUNKYARD ENGINE, TOSSING IN SOME GOOD OL’ AMERICAN INGENINUITY AND ENDING UP WITH A REALLY COOL RIG. IT’S CHEAP! IT’S FUN! AND YOU’LL BE SURPRISED WHAT YOU LEARN ON A PROJECT LIKE THIS!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What do you get when you cross the quentessential girl's car, the Mazda Miata, with the ultimate guy's car...the Shelby Cobra? Well, Gearz is the only place to find out as Stacey blows apart an innocent Miata to get it ready for its conversion into a V8 powered, screamin' machine called the "Banshee."

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Last week he made room, this week the transplant takes place as Stacey stuffs a 400 horsepower V8 into a Mazda Miata. If you've ever wondered if it's possible to actually build a blindingly fast car on a reasonable budget...The Banshee is the project you need to see. And Gearz is the olny place to see it.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on Gearz, Stacey takes you for a unique spin in one of the largest 4-wheel vehicles ever built...the LARC 60. Then it's back to the shop, where he digs into frame modifications so you can be sure the foundation is strong on your project. Then finally, he throws some cool fire-power into the back of Sgt. Rock that you are going to have to see to believe. Lock and load!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: This is a show for all of you restorers out there, because Stacey not only shows you how to properly drive your hotrod by flogging on a '70 Superbird, but he also shows you some tips and tricks on restoring vintage parts like exhaust manifolds and steering wheels. If you're a Gearhead, then this Gearz id for you.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It's anniversary time. The '32 Ford is 75 years old and we take a look back at what made this car so popular for so long. But that's not enought, no...Stacey shows you that the deuce is not dead...it's just getting started as he walks you through the assembly and building of a brand new, steel '32 roadster body at Brookville Roadsters.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee is back on Gearz and rollin' down the final stretches as Stacey installs new suspension and brakes to help control this molten missile when he uncorks that nasty V8. Even if you are not putting a V8 in your Miata, this show is full of cool things you can do to any Miata to make it look, handle, and perform better.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee gets a major facelift as Stacey transforms it from a Mazda Miata into a ...well...uh...the Banshee! that's right, the body parts fly and the cutting continues until slowly, from the mayhem, a car appears that really does look as good and run as fast as a cobra or a corvette...except the Banshee is actually affordable...And only on Gearz

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Quick...When it comes to exhaust, what is the first name that comes to your mind? If it's not Cherry Bomb, then you've missed out on a lot of years of disturbing the peace. Well, today, Stacey shows you why. Then it's a quick lesson on how to tuck your bumpers nice and tight...and a new paint product that can help you paint your car for cheap.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on gearz, it’s a real world, working man’s truck on the block, and Stacey shows you how to take a late model diesel pickup and make it better, stronger, and tougher than it was before…..and it’s something that can be done in the span of one weekend without breaking the bank. Proving once again that you can have a cool truck and still use it on the job.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: There is no doubt that the '32 Ford is one of the most legendary cars ever built. Today, Stacey shows that you can actually build one of these cars yourself, and that hot rodding is alive and well, by jumping into a wild, late '60's style raodster project called the Rat Roaster. If you were a street-racin' hot-footed muscle car driver back in 1968, this was the car that you didn't want to see pull up next to you.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Today on Gearz, Stacey deals with one of the most talked about issues facing hotrodding today—Cost! The nhe shows you that it is actually possible to build a steel-bodied, '32 roadster for around 20 grand. But you've got to get back to nature to do it. So, strap on your snake boots, buddy, cause the junk yard is calling.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Hey, What is the most important part of your project? Well, if you are building a classic or nostalgic car or truck, your answer will probably be the tires...and this week, Stacey visits Coker Tire, one of the most unique tire storkes in the country. Then it's off to run a leg of the great race in the legendary Honest Charlie '32 Ford. Finally, Stacey shows you some tips and techniques on how to get some exotic wood and a show-quality finish in the bed of your classic truck.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What is the most famous car movie of all time? Bullitt?… Vanishing point?... Gone in 60 seconds? Nice guesses, but in terms of influence and sheer popularity, Smokey and the Bandit stands above them all. Stacey takes a look at not only the cultural impact of Smokey and the Bandit, but also it’s most famous character… the black Trans Am. Then, it’s off for a test drive of Year One’s new Burt Reynolds Bandit edition Trans Am to see if it lives up to the true supercar status of the original. Finally, Stacey takes a look and shows you how to use, one of the most mysterious and versatile metal working tools out there… the English Wheel

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The “Rat Roaster” returns and Stacey finally reveals the kind of power plant that would have made this wild deuce roadster the fastest car in the valley in 1968. And if dual carbs, a blower and about 600 horsepower don’t get you going... maybe the fact that he’s stuffing a 5-speed manual transmission behind it, will! Then, Stacey digs into the Parts Bin to take a look at some of coolest products on the market to help you build your own special ride.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey not only brings the “Rat Roaster” ‘32 back in the shop, but he also takes it under the knife as he creates a very unique Dr Jekyll and Mr. Hyde style exhaust system and does some custom modifications to the frame to hide it all from the casual on-looker. If you are interested in taking your project and building it into something truly unique by thinking outside the box… this show will definitely encourage you to do that. Then, Stacey digs into some tips and tricks on how to set your vehicle up for storage for those times when your classic car or hot rod is going to be sitting for awhile unused.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: In the world of hot rodding, when gear heads gather around and start discussing their projects, invariably the conversation drifts into speculation of what the smallest thing is that you can successfully put a V8 engine in. Stacey pretty much puts an end to that speculation by building a V8 powered Barstool! It’s part go-cart… part garden tractor… part insane... and ALL hot rod, which of course is what Gearz is all about! If you like WILD… then you don’t want to miss this show! Then, Stacey dives into some Muffler Tech to show you what kind of mufflers there are on the market, and give you some tips that might help you make the right decision when the time comes to stick some cool mufflers on your machine.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When it comes to classic hot-rod components, nothing gets people going like a multi-carb setup... the Tri-power. Long admired for their stellar performance and macho attitude, the tri-power has become a hard thing to find. So why find one? Why not build your own? Stacey walks you through the process of building your own tri-power out of old derelict parts. After that, he pulls out the big Mopar guns and shows what it takes to put together a six-pack. Then, Stacey gets down and dirty and shows you how to build some simple, ultra strong axle dollies by using some old scrap metal like the kind laying around your garage. Who said gearheads aren’t into recycling?

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Banshee is back from paint and we're ready to answer the question… does it still look like a ’95 Miata? Has Stacey shown you how to create a completely different monster? Well, all we can say is the proof is in the paint and you are not going to believe how complete and affordable this transformation really is! Then, Stacey digs into the age-old question: Is it better to restore a car original, or modify it? The answer is up to you as he features a really clean ’68 Plymouth GTX… with some not-so-subtle modifications.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey pulls out the tools and starts working metal as he dives into the subject of what to do when your floors are gone… I mean literally gone…nothing there! It’s not as big of a problem as you may think! Stacey rolls in the Rat Roaster and shows you how to create solid metal floors from nothing. This show is loaded with tools and tech that will help you build anything from a small patch panel to a complete floor. While he’s at it, Stacey also covers seat selection and placement so you have a place to plant your seat when you get ready to roll down the street.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: What do you get when you combine Armor All, Tony Stewart and Stacey David with an iconic vehicle like the Corvette? You get a really cool car called “Ol’ Smoke” and some lucky viewer is going to own it! That’s right, Stacey takes a brand-new ‘Vette' and shows you how to create your own 180+ MPH supercar for a fraction of the cost, using some aftermarket parts. How is that possible?... turbos baby!... and on this show Stacey shows you how to slap a pair of ‘em on the Corvette to run the horsepower numbers to over 600! If you have ever wondered about turbo charging an if it’s right for your vehicle, this is a show you definitely want to see.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Ol' Smoke Corvette Brakes Wheels Tires
programme.desc: Ol’ Smoke is back as Stacey finishes up the transformation of a brand-new ’08 Corvette, into a full-on super car capable of running with any Ferrari, Porsche, or Lamborghini. It’s a brake upgrade, along with wheels and tires and some custom airbrushing, to not only make the car even more unique, but to also get it ready for it’s new owner to enjoy. Then, Stacey takes Ol’ Smoke out and puts it through the paces showing once again that you can not only have fun building something cool, but also having just as much fun driving it when you are done. No doubt about it, somebody is going to get a special car when Armor All gives Ol’ Smoke away.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga Tatsumi is a crazy-strong, ruthless high school delinquent who's nicknamed the "Rampaging Ogre". One day, while dunking some punk, he rescues a big guy who comes ~floating~ down the river. When he does, the big guy splits in half and out pops a bouncing baby boy! But this baby is actually Kaiser de Emperana Beelzebub IV (Baby Beel), the son of the Great Demon Lord, and he came from the Demon World in order to destroy humanity!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga has been chosen to be the parent of Beelzebub, the son of the Great Demon Lord. However Oga's suffering since every time Baby Beel cries he lets out a severe electric shock. Plus, according to Baby Beel's demon maidservant Hildegarde (Hilda), if Baby Beel moves farther than 15 meters away from his human parent Oga, the electric shock will reach lethal levels. Oga shuffles to school with Baby Beel clinging to his back, having no other choice, and begins to search for someone even stronger than him that Baby Beel will take a liking to, in order to get this monkey off his back, literally!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga loses the powdered milk that Hilda prepared for him, and instead buys a bunch of "Yogurty" from a vending machine for Beel. But it turns out that's the favorite drink of one of Ishiyama's Big Four, the "Ishiyama Tohoshinki"; the third year Kanzaki Hajime. Oga hears about how horrible and ruthless a guy Kanzaki is, and runs into the third year classroom to try and dump Baby Beel off on him. When he sees Kanzaki's evil looking face, Oga thinks that this just might be his chance!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When Oga wakes up one morning, he's floating in a great pool of water... However it is actually Baby Beel's pee, as it is "urination season" right now in the Demon World. Oga is concerned about the entire city being inundated and humanity's imminent destruction, so he takes Baby Beel to the drug store to buy some disposable diapers. While he's there, a bunch of bank robbers a take Oga, Baby Beel, Hilda and Furuichi (who were chasing after him) as hostages.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On the back of Oga's fist a mark appears that is proof of his contract with the son of the Demon Lord, Beelzebub... The Zebul Spell. After hearing that the demonic power grows as well as the Zebul Spell the more he gets into fights and runs wild, Oga decides not to fight anymore to avoid that situation. However, Himekawa Tatsuya, heir to the Himekawa Zaibatsu and one of Ishiyama's TKKH like Kanzaki, is secretly plotting to do Oga in himself, and gives the command to his lackeys...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: "A - Hilda brought back a bunch of toys from the Demon World for Baby Beel. When Oga and Hilda were assemble one, a horrible accident occurs! - B - The Zebul Spell expands when one does evil. So won't it contract if you act like an angel? ...thinks Oga, who uses a Play Doctor toy with Beel as the doctor to try and heal patients. It's time to play Demon World Doctor!"

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Park Debut... It is when you first join the community of mothers who bring their young children to the park. That day, Oga took Baby Beel to the park for his nerve-wracking debut... But the rumored BoB Brawler only manages to freak out the local mothers. During this debaucle, Oga meets fellow high schooler Kunieda Aoi and her much younger brother Kota, where he suddenly asks her to "do it" with him?!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: The Crimson Queen of the Ishiyama TKKH, who holds the deep confidence of all the women, has returned from subjugating all the Ladies of North Kanto! Hearing the rumors, Furuichi drags Oga along in trying to get a glimpse of her. Before long the Queen appears! She tries to bring the iron hammer down on Oga, who in her absence has defeated two members of Ichiyama's TKKH, and even destroyed half the school, but when she sees Oga appear in front of her...!?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Hilda hears about Kunieda Aoi from Oga and wants to find out more. She goes in search of her to test her skills. At the same time, there's someone with a half-baked scheme against Oga using Aoi's protective attitude.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A cat follows Oga home one day. Baby Beel challenges the cat for Oga's attention. Once the showdown is over, they are surrounded by stray cats, and Baby Beel stands tall to defend! This is the start of a friendship between 1 baby and 1 kitty.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Himekawa lives by the motto, "there's nothing that money can't control." In order to get revenge on Oga, he uses the power of money to work behind the scenes in plan after plan to defeat him, but Oga keeps getting the upper hand somehow…

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Oga's family is seriously worried about Baby Beel's night crying, as it's causing everyone in the entire town to lose sleep. They try all kinds of things but nothing works. Oga heads to school, completely exhausted, as do the other students looking for a fight. Everyone ends up asleep, dreaming...

Haunted by this prophecy, Sakina becomes overly protective of her son Muzamil, who grows up knowing about his fate.
